app.name: Priiloader
app.coder: DacoTaco, BadUncle and the priiloader-reborn contributors
app.long_description:
Priiloader starts before the System Menu: hold RESET while the Wii powers on to reach its menu, where it can autoboot a channel or an app, apply System Menu hacks, and recover a Wii whose System Menu does not start.
This installer installs, updates or removes Priiloader. Updating keeps your settings and hacks.
Run it with the argument install, update or remove (for example from wiiload) to do that with no buttons; the result goes to sd:/priiloader/installer_result.txt.
WARNING: installing or updating a System Menu removes Priiloader: install it again afterwards.
